title: Number of Occupants in Senior Group Homes
what_it_is: Number of Occupants in Senior Group Homes

sections.label: Senior Group Home model
sections.summary: The Senior Group Home model lets frail elderly in rental flats age in the community, with each home in a rental block holding 12 to 18 seniors.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: The Senior Group Home model supports frail elderly in rental flats to age within the community and delay premature institutionalisation of these seniors.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: The objective is that each Senior Group Home would be located in a public rental block and typically comprises six to eight rental flats which can accommodate 12 to 18 seniors.

sections.label: Adults with moderate disabilities
sections.summary: Senior Group Homes cannot support adults with moderate disabilities as there is no round-the-clock supervision, so MSF helps site them in suitable residential settings.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: The Senior Group Homes are unable to support adults with moderate disabilities as there is no round-the-clock supervision.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: For adults with special needs whose families are no longer able to look after them, MSF will take their care needs into account and help to site them in the appropriate residential setting, such as an adult disability home.

sections.label: Assistance and mutual support
sections.summary: Senior Group Homes are for those needing some assistance, and with three there may be better mutual support, though feedback is being reviewed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: The Senior Group Homes are meant for those who need some assistance and we feel that, with three, there might be the possibility of providing better mutual support.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: But having said that, we are taking on board various feedback and we are completely open to reviewing this.

sections.label: Reviewing Senior Group Homes take-up
sections.summary: Take-up of Senior Group Homes has not been overwhelming, so the model is being reviewed with MOH for possible adjustment or a better model.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: Lastly, in terms of the outcomes for the Senior Group Homes model, why does it not seem quite so popular?

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: We reckon that there is a possible need for the Senior Group Homes, but the take-up rate has not been overwhelming.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: We are looking at this to review whether we need to adjust it; whether a better model needs to be put in place.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: We are reviewing, together with MOH, the range of possibilities.
